visibleEvidence: The Top rows contain two, one and three occupied squares, so six floor cubes are compulsory. The Front peaks 3,3,1 demand two further cubes in each of the first two columns. Six plus four is attainable by raising one occupied square in each of those columns to three.
presentation: The Front and Top panels have legible headings, consistent upright grids and complete external boundaries. The accompanying stem specifies the projection alignment; its A–D labels and values are legible.
method: Independent reading of this final PNG and its full displayed stem preceded program comparison. Exact SHA-256 matches of both files preserve the same blind decision in this build.
